data.one_liner: A null-safe Flutter package for showing customizable progress dialogs.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to show, update, and hide customizable progress dialogs with text and progress indicators. It supports both normal text messages and download percentage progress types.
use_when: You need to show a loading or progress indicator overlay dialog during asynchronous tasks
You need to dynamically update the text or percentage of a progress dialog while it is shown
avoid_when: You prefer inline progress indicators instead of blocking dialogs
You want a fully declarative state management approach for loading states
strengths: Supports dynamic content updates while the dialog is visible
Customizable styling options for text styles, background color, and progress widgets
weaknesses: Imperative API approach rather than declarative widget state
Requires context to initialize and control the dialog
